llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is coherent with its purpose: it opens Douyin search in the browser and extracts visible public search results, with only minor activation-scope and external-browsing notes.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, metadata, and instructions consistently describe searching Douyin by keyword and returning visible results; it explicitly says it does not download, post, interact with content, or bypass login walls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md activation rules are Douyin-scoped, but skill.json includes broad triggers such as “搜索一下” and “帮我找,” which could cause the skill to be selected for a generic search request. This is low impact because the skill only performs browser-based searching.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files; the artifact is instruction-only, so there is no package execution, helper script, or dependency risk shown.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires browser use and navigation to douyin.com, which is expected for the purpose. Users should understand their search terms are sent to Douyin and the page may show login or captcha prompts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts do not request credentials, local files, persistent storage, privileged access, background execution, or account mutation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This looks safe to install for browser-based Douyin searching. Be aware that search terms are sent to Douyin, and the broad trigger phrases may be worth narrowing if you do not want the skill considered for generic search requests.

evidence.explanation: Two trigger phrases are generic search/help phrases rather than clearly Douyin-specific, so the skill might be considered for a broader user request than intended.
evidence.snippet: "triggers": ["搜索抖音", "搜一下抖音", "抖音搜索", "找抖音视频", "douyin search", "搜索一下", "帮我找"]

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Keep the skill enabled if you want Douyin search, but prefer narrower triggers that include Douyin/抖音 context.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent could choose Douyin search when the user only asked a generic “search” or “help me find” request, though the resulting action is limited to browser search.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to use the browser tool to send the extracted keyword to Douyin and inspect the resulting page; this is expected and central to the stated purpose.
evidence.snippet: Use the built-in `browser` tool: `browser(action="open", url="https://www.douyin.com/search/海鲜")`

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it for public Douyin searches and avoid entering sensitive search terms if you do not want them sent to Douyin.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Your search keyword will be used on Douyin’s website, and Douyin may display login, captcha, or limited public results.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses the browser as expected, but some metadata triggers are broad enough to notice.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account privileges, local system permissions, or mutation authority are requested.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, local private data indexing, credential stores, or inter-agent data flows are shown.
